data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Add 2 additional tests: (a) test_unauthorized_leaf_non_dso_id_label_write_does_not_raise — invoke unauthorized leaf writing label with payload that does NOT start with 'dso-id-' (e.g., 'custom-tag-foo') → no DsoIdLabelWriteError raised (confirms guard's payload prefix check is a filter, not blanket label prohibition). (b) Add explicit apply()-level integration test per task-2 revision: invoke apply() (NOT _audit directly) with mutation triggering unauthorized dso-id write → DsoIdLabelWriteError propagates out of apply(). Keep direct _audit unit tests as supplementary. test_dso_id_label_writers.py is the SHARED test module (created in task-2, extended here).
